name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low light and keeps the interface sleek, matching competitors like Manus and Graphify. The trade-off is that light mode may feel less readable for some users in bright environments, but the toggle keeps flexibility. This balances visibility and enjoyment without overcomplicating the design.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes hide errors and muted colors—users miss critical data if they assume visibility is fine. A high-contrast light theme solves that but risks alienating users who prefer dark interfaces. The real test is A/B testing both themes with error detection tasks; whichever catches mistakes faster wins.
